notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
nc TARGET 873 probes rsync daemon and triggers share listing (#list) without any credentials. Returns available share names and their descriptions before any authentication attempt.

=== CHAINING ===
nc probe → list share names → rsync -av --list-only rsync://target/share → see contents → rsync download for files of interest.

=== WHY NC FIRST ===
The initial nc probe reveals share names without authentication. Some shares listed may not be accessible without creds — enumerate names first, then attempt access per-share.
